notes.title: No Update This Month, Updates Now Coming Every Other Month
notes.notes:
If you read the game's description you know that there were going to be free updates every month. I have done that, but I can't do it for much longer.

I am moving the updates to every other month so I can work on other projects. I am working on a few right now and I want to finish them.

I also have lots of school work to do. As you know schools as started up again very recently or are starting soon.

I do hope that this is a decision you guys are fine with. Other than this the game is doing pretty well. It's close to having 15 thousand downloads. When it does I'll do something special

notes.title: Update 1.2 Is Out
notes.notes:
1.2 is out for Endersite. Endersite was given negative feedback for no scene transitions, no single-player content,  and no way to find what buttons do what. All of those examples have been fixed, they may not be 100 percent fixed. For example, the single-player content is like an adventure mode. I hope I can have more feedback, I have been loving the feedback you guys have been giving me. So thank you for all of the feedback and I will be working to make this game the best it can be.

                -Lilkkgoog
